decisions.reason: Specifying base 10 blocks as the third visual object type does not change the question-review sequence or the required count of three questions per level.
The selected visual object type does not alter how related levels are split or arranged for curriculum-based gradual progression.
The visual representation assigned to Type 3 does not change the rule for copying a question into each applicable level.
Choosing base 10 blocks as a visual representation neither resolves the disputed Grade 5 topic coverage nor changes curriculum-alignment requirements.
The Type 3 visual object choice does not change the deferred C# random-generator requirement or its execution constraints.
